name: STACloud phpMyAdmin
author: stacloud.dev@gmail.com
description: Standalone phpMyAdmin at /. Select a compatible phpMyAdmin release and PHP 5.6-8.5 image. Configure database host, port and verified TLS; sign in with database credentials.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
mkdir -p /mnt/server
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.stacloud
if [ ! -e /mnt/server/.stacloud/php.ini ]; then
    ( set -C; cat > /mnt/server/.stacloud/php.ini <<'INI'
; STACloud custom PHP settings. Restart after editing.
; Active directives override the PHP fields in Startup.
; memory_limit = 256M
; upload_max_filesize = 64M
; post_max_size = 80M
; date.timezone = Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh
; max_input_vars = 5000
INI
    )
fi
echo "STACloud phpMyAdmin: files preserved; phpMyAdmin is installed on first startup."

variables.name: Standalone phpMyAdmin
variables.description: Dedicated phpMyAdmin service at the site root; installed automatically on startup.

variables.name: phpMyAdmin Version
variables.description: latest or an exact published release, e.g. 4.9.11 or 5.2.3. Choose a release compatible with the PHP image: phpMyAdmin 4.9 needs PHP 5.5+, 5.0/5.1 need PHP 7.1.3+, 5.2 needs PHP 7.2.5+. Latest may require newer PHP.

variables.name: Database Host for phpMyAdmin
variables.description: External MySQL/TiDB host supported. For TiDB Cloud enter gateway01.ap-southeast-1.prod.aws.tidbcloud.com.

variables.name: Database Port for phpMyAdmin
variables.description: Database server port: 3306 for standard MySQL, 4000 for TiDB Cloud.

variables.name: Verified Database TLS for phpMyAdmin
variables.description: Enable verified TLS when connecting to TiDB Cloud or other TLS databases.

variables.name: PHP Memory Limit
variables.description: PHP memory per process; the container RAM limit still applies.

variables.name: PHP Upload Max Filesize
variables.description: Maximum size of one uploaded file. Keep Post Max Size larger.

variables.name: PHP Post Max Size
variables.description: Maximum POST request size. Also check Web Max Body Size.

variables.name: PHP Max Execution Time
variables.description: PHP execution timeout in seconds; 0 disables the PHP timeout.

variables.name: PHP Display Errors
variables.description: Show PHP errors in responses. Keep Off on public production websites.

variables.name: Custom php.ini File
variables.description: Custom INI file relative to server files. .stacloud/php.ini is created automatically without overwriting edits. Restart to apply; active settings override the PHP fields above.

variables.name: Web Max Body Size
variables.description: Nginx request body limit, e.g. 320m or 1g; 0 disables it. Legacy PHP images use PHP limits instead.
